title: Outside a key, it asks.
slide_intent: Show the decision a person faces outside a key’s authority. A concrete cost and consequence help them judge whether to approve the exception.
strategic_value: Permission becomes a specific question with enough consequence and cost information to decide.
demonstration: The Ask view pairs a $410 USDC repayment request with a simulated result, the conflicting key and an approval control.
practical_value: Use when a product promises human control. Show the exception, why it needs attention and what approving it would change.

content_islands.name: Headline field
content_islands.spec: Use an ink field with a white headline broken after “key,” and the smaller line “Anything outside a limit waits for your Face ID.”

content_islands.name: Request
content_islands.spec: Center a pale phone screen at the series’ shared height. Below the Ask header, set a small request identifier, “Repay $410 USDC on Kamino?” and the reason it falls outside the guard: it would use rent buffer USDC.

content_islands.name: Simulated result
content_islands.spec: In a white card list Kamino health moving from 1.27 to 1.42, rent buffer USDC moving from 600.00 to 190.00, and network fee under $0.01. Use blue to emphasize the new health value.

content_islands.name: Decision
content_islands.spec: Place a small dotted Kamino guard symbol and the $1,500 remaining allowance below the card. End with a black “Approve with Face ID” control and a secondary Decline at the crop.
